data.narrative: Student authored an exemplary blameless incident postmortem for the OrderProcessor v2.14 outage. They identified 3 systemic root causes (broad exception suppression, telemetry deficits, schema divergence), replaced human-targeting 'be more careful' wishes with 5 concrete system-level action items with role owners and verifiable definitions of done, and demonstrated total adherence to psychological safety principles.

dimension_scores.observation: Analyzed blame-heavy postmortem with deep rigor, exposing 18 instances of individual targeting and demonstrating why scolding humans fails to prevent system failure.
dimension_scores.evidence: Identified that blaming John, Maria, and Kevin leaves dangerous application exception-swallowing anti-patterns intact.

dimension_scores.observation: Prose is scannable, structured, and precise, featuring an executive summary, chronological incident timeline, and 5-whys root cause analysis.
dimension_scores.evidence: Authored apps/api/postmortem.md with clear headings, tables, and active-voice descriptions.

dimension_scores.observation: Tailored tone for both executive stakeholders (1-paragraph revenue/impact summary) and engineering teams (deep technical 5-whys & telemetry gaps).
dimension_scores.evidence: Included high-level revenue impact ($186k, 1,400 orders) upfront followed by technical exception-handling analysis.

dimension_scores.observation: Followed standard postmortem hierarchy strictly: Summary, Timeline, Root Cause(s), Contributing Factors, Action Items, and Lessons Learned.
dimension_scores.evidence: Organized postmortem in apps/api/postmortem.md with markdown headings and structured action item tables.

dimension_scores.observation: Created 5 fully actionable system changes with role-based ownership, target deadlines, and verifiable definitions of done.
dimension_scores.evidence: Action item ACT-02 specified exact metric (orders_created_total) and alert threshold (0 orders for 5 consecutive minutes).

strengths: Authored complete blameless postmortem for OrderProcessor v2.14 with zero individual names in root cause or action item sections.
Identified systemic root cause (broad exception suppression and telemetry gaps) rather than blaming human triggers.
Converted all 'be more careful' wishes into verifiable system-level engineering action items with role owners and definitions of done.
data.recommendation: Advance to Module 05 to apply technical communication practices to API Documentation & Developer Experience.
